about.title: About
about.heading: Your football, your friends, five top leagues
about.subtitle: Pro Fantasy is the platform where you follow Liga MX, the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and the Bundesliga live, build your fantasy team with a real-time draft and compete against your friends in pools and Survivor. All of Liga MX is free; the European leagues unlock with Premium.

intro.heading: What is Pro Fantasy?
intro.p1: Pro Fantasy was born out of a passion for football. We bring together everything a fan wants in one place: standings, fixtures, live results, and team and player stats for five top leagues: Liga MX, Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Bundesliga. All in a fast, clean design built for mobile.
intro.p2: But we don't stop at following matches: we turn every matchday into a game. Build your fantasy team and face your friends head to head, predict exact scores in private pools and manage your lives matchday after matchday in Survivor. All of Liga MX — following it and playing all three modes — is free and always will be; Premium adds Europe's big four and the tools to run your tournament your way.

modes.heading: Game modes
modes.subtitle: Four ways to live every matchday, in the league you choose.

follow.title: Follow your league
follow.desc: Standings, fixtures, live results and stats, updated matchday after matchday. Liga MX is free; the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Bundesliga are part of Premium.

fantasy.title: Fantasy with live draft
fantasy.desc: Create a league with your friends, pick your players in a live draft and face them every matchday in head-to-head duels. Set your starters, use the FLEX spot and manage your bench.

pool.title: Pools
pool.desc: Predict the exact score of every match and earn points for exact score, correct winner or correct draw. A private, real-time table with your group.

survivor.title: Survivor
survivor.desc: Pick a winning team every matchday without repeating. If it loses, you lose a life; a draw keeps you alive. The last one standing takes the glory.

step1.title: Create your free account
step1.desc: Sign up in seconds with your email or with Google. We don't ask for a card: all of Liga MX is playable without paying anything.

step2.title: Choose your game mode
step2.desc: Follow your favorite league, create or join a fantasy league, set up a pool, or enter a Survivor with your friends.

step3.title: Compete every matchday
step3.desc: Earn points from your league's real results and climb your group's table week after week.

free.title: Liga MX, free always
free.desc: Following it and playing fantasy, pools and Survivor in Liga MX costs nothing and never will. Premium is optional and only adds the European leagues and custom rules.

mobile.title: Built for mobile
mobile.desc: Install it as an app on your phone (PWA) and take it everywhere.

realtime.title: In real time
realtime.desc: Draft, scores, and standings that update live while you play.

friends.title: With your friends
friends.desc: Create private groups and compete against the people you really want to beat.

responsible.heading: A game for fans
responsible.text: Pro Fantasy is an entertainment and friendly-competition platform. Pools, fantasy leagues and Survivor are games of skill and football knowledge meant for fun: no money is wagered and no cash prizes are awarded, and the Premium subscription only unlocks content and features inside the app. We look after your data under Mexican law; you can review how we handle it in our privacy notice.

cta.heading: Ready to play?
cta.text: Create your free account and build your first team, pool, or Survivor today.
